title: Renewal and changes of law for critical honeycomb walks
summary: For critical honeycomb self-avoiding walk, we prove spatial exponent 3/4 for the infinite irreducible-bridge law and for bridges of every sufficiently large compatible even length. We establish the corresponding thermal laws at every large discount scale, including all positive length and spatial moments. For unrestricted uniform walks, the endpoint lower law holds on a common set of lengths of natural density one.
